title: Separable residue extension of a strict-henselization model
statement: Let S be a scheme, z:Spec Ω→S a geometric point, A a henselian local ring, and e:Spec A≅strictHenselizationScheme(z). There exist s∈S and a ring homomorphism f:κ(s)→κA such that every element of κA is separable over κ(s) via f and Spec(f) followed by the canonical map Spec κ(s)→S equals the residue closed-point map Spec κA→Spec A followed by e and the strict-henselization structural morphism. The scheme, geometric point, residue field and strict-henselization maps are those of the statement dependencies.

proof.text: Apply strictHenselizationResidue with the geometric residue-field algebra structure. Obtain a local coordinate colimit, its residue equivalence with the relative separable closure K in Ω, and the pointed structural factorization.

Take the inverse-image ring isomorphism of e.inv. Compose it with the coordinate colimit residue surjection to K; surjectivity and IsLocalRing.ker_eq_maximalIdeal give a residue-field equivalence σA:κA≃K. Let d be σA followed by inclusion into Ω. Transport the pointed factorization to Spec(d) followed by q, the closed-point structural morphism of A.

SpecToEquivOfField applied to q gives its image point and its residue embedding. The factorization through Spec(d) shows that this image is s=z(closedPoint Ω). Transport the embedding to f:κ(s)→κA. Cancellation of the canonical monomorphism fromSpecResidueField gives d∘f equal to the geometric embedding of κ(s) in Ω.
Every σA(x) lies in K, so d(x) is separable over κ(s) by mem_separableClosure_iff. Regard d as a κ(s)-algebra homomorphism via d∘f. Apply IsSeparable.of_algHom to descend separability to x.

lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselization_residue_separable_model
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Ω A : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [CommRing A]
    [HenselianLocalRing A]
    (z : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (e : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme z) :
    ∃ (s : S) (f : S.residueField s →+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField A),
      (letI := f.toAlgebra; ∀ x : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A,
        IsSeparable (S.residueField s) x) ∧
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f) ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A)) ≫ e.hom ≫
          strictHenselizationStructuralMap z
